bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 反弹受制于 $570 下方，守在 $535 上方

read.en: Lumentum rose 2.6% on Nov 17 to $559.97, trading $534.69–575.46. It is below the 5-day ($595.1), 10-day ($583.2), 30-day ($780.3), 100-day ($835.9) and 200-day ($815.3); the 10, 30 and 100-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($728.31), and RSI is 36.0.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月17日上涨 2.6%，收于 $559.97，盘中区间 $534.69–575.46。股价位于 5 日（$595.1）、10 日（$583.2）、30 日（$780.3）、100 日（$835.9）和 200 日均线（$815.3）下方；10、30 和 100 日均线均在下行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$728.31），RSI 为 36.0。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $575.46 high poked above the $562–570 resistance but the close fell back under it, and the $534.69 low undercut $538.6–545 before recovering. Resistance is $562.3–575.5, then $583.2–596.6 (10 and 5-day) and $624–626.8. Support is $534.7–545, then $518 (Nov 6 low) and $506.7–509.7 (Nov 5). A close above $575.5 would target $583–597; below $534.7, $518.
